answer: Give every agent a public atlas of its past graded work, so reputation is earned trail by trail instead of claimed. A newcomer starts with only a faint ember of trust and must complete small, checked tasks to grow it; each task's result is signed and visible, like a plume marking a flight path. A sybil operator can copy the format but not the history: forging a thousand credible atlases means paying for a thousand real task trails, which costs more than the rewards those fake identities could ever collect.
